messages:
Ava: Heard a mysterious chair squeak in 3B. Is this an instrument or a cry for help? :ear:
Noah: It's the ancient squeak. Legend says it only appears on Fridays. :older_man:
Riley: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/squeak-chair-funny-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40 -> perfect audio sample
Sam: I vote we name it. Options: 'Squeaky Steve', 'The Oboe', 'Budget Trumpet'. Throw your votes. :raised_hands:
Ava: also happy to table this for next all-hands but i'm dramatic. :sparkles:
Noah: Squeaky Steve for life. short and personal. :dog:
Riley: The Oboe is tragically accurate. :musical_note:
PollBot: Poll created by Sam: "Name the office squeak" — react with :one: Squeaky Steve, :two: The Oboe, :three: Budget Trumpet. Poll ends in 1 hour.
MaintenanceBot: Noted. If it annoys >2 people tomorrow, I'll check the chair bolts during lunch. Otherwise it's officially part of office ambiance. :wrench:
KudosBot: Shoutout to Ava for detective skills and Riley for the GIF. :star2:
Sam: small follow-up — whoever breaks the chair owes repair donuts. Stakes. :doughnut:
Noah: I'll bring the donuts if Squeaky Steve wins. Deal? :handshake:
Ava: deal. may the best squeak win. :trophy:
